subclass_Agent: subclass the Agent class to build a custom agent for the habitat environment
implement_Agent_reset: implement the reset method of the Agent class to initialize state before a new episode
implement_Agent_act: implement the act method of the Agent class to return an action given observations
review_Agent_class: review the Agent abstract class and its reset and act method signatures
refactor_Agent_subclass: refactor a custom Agent subclass to return a Dict action from the act method
